name: Wabtec
description: Wabtec supplies the rail industry: new and modernized locomotives, replacement parts and maintenance contracts for them, braking and other components for freight cars, signalling and digital rail software, and components for passenger trains, subways and buses. About 72% of sales is the Freight segment, where services (parts and maintenance for roughly 24,600 locomotives in service) are the largest piece, and 28% is Transit, where aftermarket is larger than original-equipment sales. The installed base generates recurring parts and service revenue, and a $27.4B backlog (December 2025) gives multi-year visibility, though orders can be delayed or cancelled. It also bought Frauscher (train detection, about $792M) and Evident's Inspection Technologies division (about $1.797B, July 2025).

hq.note: 30 Isabella Street, Pittsburgh, PA 15212 (10-K); Delaware corporation

employees.note: approximately 31,000 excluding contingent workers; operations in over 50 countries

businessLines.name: Freight Segment
businessLines.how: Locomotive sales priced per unit to railroads and miners, recurring aftermarket parts and multi-year maintenance contracts on an installed base, and components to freight-car builders.
businessLines.description: Locomotives, locomotive services, freight-car components, Digital Intelligence (rail control and software), and industrial components. FY2025 sales by product: Services $3,055M, Equipment $2,365M, Components $1,586M, Digital Intelligence $1,030M.

businessLines.name: Transit Segment
businessLines.how: Components sold per vehicle to transit-vehicle builders and aftermarket parts, repair and HVAC/door replacement to transit authorities.
businessLines.description: Components, refurbishment and services for passenger trains, subway cars, light rail and buses: Original Equipment Manufacturer $1,393M, Aftermarket $1,738M.

brands.name: Frauscher Sensor Technology
brands.share: Acquired 2025 for about $792M; rail detection; inside Freight; revenue not separately stated in text read

brands.name: Evident Inspection Technologies
brands.share: Acquired July 1, 2025 for about $1.797B; non-destructive testing and inspection; segment assignment and revenue not stated in text read
